technique_name: Describe the behavior and characteristics of a falcon
description: Falcons are swift and powerful birds of prey, named for their characteristic long, pointed wings and the sharp talons they use to catch their prey. They feed mainly on medium-sized birds, reptiles, and other small animals. Falcons are known for their remarkable flying technique, which involves hovering and sudden dives to hunt prey.
